title: Moralis Streams Integration — Sub-Second Copy-Trade Pipeline
context: Transitioned from high-latency polling (30s) to push-based Moralis Streams webhooks for sub-second EVM event detection. Created closed-loop: discover → monitor → copy-trade.
problem: The bot was polling Moralis every 30s for wallet transactions, creating a 30-60s latency gap. Smart money could move tokens significantly in that window. Additionally, sniper discovery and wallet monitoring were independent systems — newly discovered alpha wallets didn't get added to real-time monitoring.

solution.moralis_streams_webhook: core/moralis_streams.py — Secure webhook handler with sha3(body+secret) verification, NOT HMAC-SHA256. Routes events by stream tag (alpha/whale/liquidity).
solution.streams_lifecycle_manager: core/moralis_streams_manager.py — Auto-creates streams on Moralis, syncs wallet addresses, health-checks every 5 mins, auto-recreates terminated streams.
solution.hybrid_mode: wallet_monitor.py — When Streams active, polling extends to 120s as safety fallback, reducing API consumption by 75%.
solution.discovery_to_streams: sniper_discovery.py — After promoting new wallets, auto-syncs them to Moralis Streams manager for immediate sub-second monitoring.
solution.infrastructure: docker-compose.yml — Port 8787 exposed for webhook ingestion.

key_patterns.moralis_streams_create: Use PUT (not POST) to create streams at api.moralis-streams.com/streams/evm
key_patterns.moralis_streams_signature: Verify with sha3(body_bytes + secret_bytes), compare to x-signature header
key_patterns.moralis_webhook_path: Moralis sends confirmed + unconfirmed webhooks, must handle both

remaining_gaps: getSwapsByWalletAddress — validate sniper wallets actually make DEX swaps before promoting
searchEntities — identify exchange hot wallets for outflow detection
getTokenBondingStatus — check pump.fun graduation before buying Solana memes
getPairStats — per-pair buy/sell ratio analysis for entry timing

learnings: Moralis uses sha3 for webhook signature verification, NOT HMAC-SHA256
Moralis Streams API base URL is api.moralis-streams.com, separate from data API
Stream creation uses PUT method, not POST
allAddresses: true (whale detection) may require Business tier subscription
Hybrid polling is critical — Streams alone has no Solana support
Closed-loop architecture (discover → monitor → copy) maximizes reaction speed
Port 8787 must be exposed in Docker AND firewall on VPS
